title: cyclosorus truncatus
intro: Cyclosorus truncatus, commonly known as the Truncated Lady Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus truncatus include its antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
